FOLIO NO. 02 — LATEST ARRIVAL

The Black Barn returns to the spring calendar.

After a quiet winter — new flooring, a refurbished kitchen, and a new chimney — the Black Barn at Korsbakken reopens its doors on the third of May. Photographer Olia Brandt has re-shot the property in soft morning light. Reservations open for the season the following Tuesday.

Re-opens · 3 May 2025
Bookings open · 7 May
Re-photographed by Olia Brandt
Press preview · Sat 27 Apr

FOLIO NO. 03 — COMING QUIETLY

Casa Encinal, between fog and fire.

Of all the houses in the portfolio, Casa Encinal is the one we have often photographed at four in the afternoon — when the light arrives sideways through the lemon trees. This autumn, we open the house to a private viewing before reservations reopen.

Reservations open · 10 October
Private viewings · By invitation
Letters to the Bandol & the Olive Press
